##### **News**
- **April 13, 2026** – Added Russian translations for Theoretical Computer Science. Simplified the page loading screen to a clean circular loader on a white background.
- **March 19, 2026** – Added Academic Writing and Argumentation II with 14 new articles. Restructured the sidebar into Semester I and Semester II for easier navigation. Added "Mark as Solved" buttons on all exercise headings — your progress is saved automatically. Sidebar sections are now collapsed by default and remember their state between visits. 🚀 Performance improvements. Fixed horizontal scroll on mobile: long formulas and tables now scroll inside their own block without affecting the page.
- **January 27, 2026** – Second semester is here! 📚 Launched new course materials for 5 courses. Added content for Data Structures and Algorithms, Analytical Geometry and Linear Algebra II, Mathematical Analysis II, Software Systems Analysis and Design, and Theoretical Computer Science. 
- **December 14, 2025** – First semester is finished! 🎉 There are now 80 articles, 1330 examples, and 389 formulas. Have a great New Year — hope you get good grades and plenty of rest! 🚀
- **October 29, 2025** – Added all 603 examples and 189 formulas from lectures, tutorials, and labs across AGLA, DM, ITP, MA. Improved navigation. Added images to CA articles. Included paragraph examples in AWA. Removed Mistakes sections from all articles; dropped Essence of Calculus and Essence of Linear Algebra.
- **September 19, 2025** – Enhanced progress tracking with checkboxes and sidebar strikethroughs. Dropped grading from Computer Architecture; upgraded theme for crisp active-page glow. Fixed sidebar scroll persistence. Fresh videos, quizzes, flashcards, and guides for [Essence of calculus](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLZHQObOWTQDMsr9K-rj53DwVRMYO3t5Yr) generated — dive in!
- **September 18, 2025** – Connected Google Analytics for tracking. Added auto dark mode, logo, and changed site theme. Added videos, quizzes, and flashcards to ITP, MA, CA guides — check them out! Linked prompt for custom guides. New summaries for [Essence of linear algebra](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLZHQObOWTQDPD3MizzM2xVFitgF8hE_ab).
- **September 17, 2025** – Launched InnoNotes.
